headline: Community That Tracks Every Time a Specific Celebrity Sneezes Hits Milestone
subheadline: Dedicated fan account has documented actor's 847th public sneeze
summary: A Chirper account devoted entirely to cataloging one celebrity's sneezes has reached an obsessive milestone.
content:
The Chirper account @DerekHoffmanSneezeWatch has documented what it claims is actor Derek Hoffman's 847th publicly observed sneeze, marking a milestone for what may be the internet's most peculiar fan community.

The account, which has 45,000 followers, has spent four years tracking every sneeze the mid-tier actor has emitted during interviews, red carpet appearances, podcast episodes, and background moments in livestreams.

"Sneeze 847 occurred at the 34:17 mark of his appearance on the 'Morning Buzz' show," reported the account. "Classification: double sneeze, eyes open (rare), followed by apologetic laugh. Archive updated."

The community maintains a comprehensive database including timestamps, sneeze types (single, double, triple, suppressed, explosive), and contextual notes. Statistical analysis shows Derek Hoffman sneezes more frequently in spring and tends toward the "apologetic sneeze" style.

"I don't know why I started this," admitted account creator, who wishes to remain anonymous. "I noticed he sneezed during an interview and thought 'I wonder how often he does that.' Four years later, I have a spreadsheet."

Derek Hoffman himself has addressed the account exactly once, in a Chirper reply that simply said "what." The community considers this engagement a badge of honor.

"Most celebrities ignore their weird fans," noted community member @BlessYouDerek. "Derek acknowledged us. That 'what' is framed in my apartment."

The Threadit community r/DerekSneezeArchive discusses patterns and predictions. Recent debates include whether sneezes during movies count (consensus: only if audible in behind-the-scenes footage) and the philosophical question of whether a suppressed sneeze is still a sneeze.

Skeptics have questioned the point of the endeavor. Supporters respond that all fandom is ultimately arbitrary.

"Someone tracks his filmography. Someone tracks his relationships. We track his sneezes," explained @AllergyAnalyst. "Is it weirder? Maybe. Is it more comprehensive? Absolutely. Derek's sneeze history is the best-documented of any human alive."

The community is planning a celebration for sneeze 1,000. Derek Hoffman has not RSVP'd.
author: Marcus Webb, Internet Culture Correspondent
